title: Regression: Mounted sub-app OpenAPI paths do not include the root path
body: ### First Check - [X] I added a very descriptive title here. - [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it. - [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search. - [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information. - [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer. - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic). - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui). - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc). ### Commit to Help - [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆 ### Example Code ```python from fastapi import FastAPI app = FastAPI() @app.get("/app") def read_main(): return {"message": "Hello World from main app"} subapi = FastAPI() @subapi.get("/sub") def read_sub(): return {"message": "Hello World from sub API"} app.mount("/subapi", subapi) ``` ### Description The OpenAPI paths generated by FastAPI for `subapi` are supposed to be prefixed with the mount path `"/subapi"`, they are not. This causes an incorrect openapi.json to be generated that cannot be used with Swagger UI and does not work as the documentation says: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/sub-applications/#sub-application **Expected** (see image in https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/sub-applications/#sub-application) **Actual** ### Operating System Linux ### Operating System Details _No response_ ### FastAPI Version 0.128.0 ### Pydantic Version 2.12.5 ### Python Version Python 3.14.2 ### Additional Context I ran the code example using: `python -m uvicorn main:app`. The given code example was the content of a module named main.py.

Commit to Help

 I commit to help with one of those options 👆

Example Code
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()


@app.get("/app")
def read_main():
    return {"message": "Hello World from main app"}


subapi = FastAPI()


@subapi.get("/sub")
def read_sub():
    return {"message": "Hello World from sub API"}


app.mount("/subapi", subapi)
Description
The OpenAPI paths generated by FastAPI for subapi are supposed to be prefixed with the mount path "/subapi", they are not. This causes an incorrect openapi.json to be generated that cannot be used with Swagger UI and does not work as the documentation says: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/sub-applications/#sub-application
